description: gtfs_Ligne transport en commun de Grand Paris Sudm is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Opendata de Grand Paris Sud. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal shows 1,972 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
